paper_title: APT Improving Specialist LLM Performance with Weakness Case Acquisition   and Iterative Preference Training
caption: The exploration of hyperparameters.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy percentage of a model, denoted as "Dolly," as a function of the parameter α. The x-axis, labeled “α,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4, with tick labels spaced evenly at intervals of 1 unit. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, is a linear scale ranging from approximately 22.75% to 23.75%, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1%. A solid blue line, displaying circular markers at each data point, represents the Dolly model’s accuracy; the line begins at approximately 23.75% at α = 0 and decreases linearly to approximately 22.85% at α = 4.
